messages:
clara (CS): Quick ask — Pavo goes live tomorrow. They're flagged as renewal-watch. Can someone assemble a tiny, customer-facing "mini-runbook" (one page) for 0-48h: short prefill checklist, recommended batching by prompt size, streaming sanity checks, a 2-question feedback ping, and a paste-ready smoke test? Need customer-friendly wording + an engineer note.
omar (CS): I'll draft something concise. Plan: 4 bullets customers can copy, plus an 'Engineer note' appendix with a curl they can run. Also add a tiny checkbox they can send back to confirm they've run the steps.
mira (eng-runtime): I'll supply the smoke test and tolerances. Proposal: 1) send 10 short warmup requests to prime tokenizer + KV cache; 2) send 30 streaming requests at ~150ms intervals; 3) confirm first-chunk latency <1600ms and KV hit rate >80% after warmup. If these fail, escalate. I'll include a small paste-ready curl.
jess (support): Escalation thresholds to include: error rate >=2% over 5m OR median generation latency >2s -> open urgent ticket with trace_id + 2 example prompts. Feedback webhook will auto-create a ticket if they use it. Add support link and expected response SLAs.
prewarm-bot: Notification: Pavo dedicated warmup scheduled tonight 01:45 UTC.
omar (CS): Customer copy (very short):
- Step 1 (Warmup): Run the prefill script (10 short requests).
- Step 2 (Batching): Apply batching heuristic — short prompts (<128 tokens): batch=32; medium (128-512): batch=8-16; long (>512): batch=4-8.
- Step 3 (Smoke test): Run the quick smoke test (paste the curl below). Confirm streaming chunks start quickly.
- Step 4 (Feedback): After 24h, answer two short questions (Yes/No + optional note).
mira (eng-runtime): Engineer note (paste-ready):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"warmup","stream":true,"batch_size":8}'
```
Quick pass criteria to communicate: HTTP 200, first stream chunk <=1600ms, KV hit rate >80% after 10 warmups. If KV hit rate remains low, increase prefill_count to 30 or extend TTL. If stream chunks delayed or truncated, switch to non-streaming endpoint and capture trace_id.
jess (support): Feedback form (2 questions) — we'll provide a tiny link customers can click: Q1: "Were the responses useful?" (Yes / No). Q2: "If no or issues, brief note." Submissions post to https://hooks.redwood.ai/pavo-feedback and create a ticket tagged onboard/pavo.
omar (CS): Troubleshooting cheats (very brief):
- "No chunks": check API key & network. Run curl above. If still no, switch to non-streaming and send trace_id.
- "Low KV hits": run more warmups (30), ensure tenant id consistent, or ask CSM to request extra prewarm.
- "High latency": reduce batch_size, inspect prompt length distribution, confirm region routing.
mira (eng-runtime): Also add an internal note for CSMs: if they report low KV hits after 30 warmups, file an infra prewarm request (include tenant id + recent logs).
omar (CS): I'll assemble the one-pager PDF + plain-text run commands and post to #customer-success and DM the Pavo CSM by EOD. Clara — should I include an optional short checkbox they can return?
clara (CS): Yes please — include a tiny 3-item checkbox snippet they can paste back to us. That'll help the onboarding flow. Thanks team :thumbsup:
